summary: Trump and Xi appear to have maintained a fragile truce in the US-China trade war after their Beijing summit. The meeting concluded with few breakthroughs — China agreed to buy 200 Boeing jets, but key claims on farm goods went unconfirmed by Beijing. The limited scope of the deal is fueling stocks and tech while leaving bonds under pressure from elevated real rates and a Fed in no hurry to cut.
tweet: The Beijing summit wrapped with a trade truce but no real deal — equities are buying the headline, bonds are not.
